summary:
Designed and verified a 5-stage CMOS ring oscillator on the GF180MCU-D PDK using 3.3V devices (nfet_03v3 / pfet_03v3) in a single schematic file lo_tb.sch.

**Circuit:**
- 5 inverter stages in a ring (odd number → oscillation)
- Each inverter: pfet W=12µm, nfet W=5µm (pfet/nfet ratio ≈ 2.4×), L=0.28µm, nf=2
- VDD = 3.3 V supply
- 1 pF load capacitor per stage (C1–C5) to bring frequency into the 20–200 MHz target range
- .ic V(OSC1)=0 kick-start to break metastable DC point
- Transient analysis: .tran 0.1n 2u

**Simulation evidence (from analyze_raw on lo_tb_v2.raw, 20008 points over 2 µs):**
- All 5 ring nodes (OSC1–OSC5) show sustained rail-to-rail oscillation:
  - Vpp ≈ 3.30 V (requirement: > 2.5 V) ✓
  - Min ≈ 0 V, Max ≈ 3.30 V, Mean ≈ 1.64 V (≈ VDD/2)
- FFT dominant peak: 103.0 MHz, amplitude 1.901
  - 3rd harmonic at 308.5 MHz has amplitude 0.321 (5.9× weaker)
  - Clear single dominant frequency ✓
- Oscillation frequency: ~103 MHz (within 20–200 MHz target) ✓
